01 / The Critical Reality

The Problem: Why Traditional Weather Systems Fail

In Bangladesh, over 70 million individuals work outdoors—farming alluvial deltas, hauling rickshaws in boiling heat, or steering wooden fishing trawlers into the turbulent Bay of Bengal. Yet current early warning mechanisms suffer from three catastrophic structural flaws:

Spatial Mismatch

1. The Granularity Gap

Standard smartphone apps deliver forecasts averaged over sprawling metropolitan zones. A single district covers thousands of square kilometers. Heavy convective cloudbursts in one upazila are completely invisible to an app displaying "partly cloudy" for the whole district.

Occupational Void

2. The Disconnect in Meaning

Rain is not just rain. To an Aman rice farmer during harvest, 25mm of rain destroys stored crops; during sowing, it is a blessing. To a coastal fisherman, a river warning #2 vs a marine sea warning #4 dictates whether they face calm inland waters or death in deep waters.

Trust & Provenance

3. The Bulletin Barrier

Official BMD (Bangladesh Meteorological Department) notices are published as dense, bureaucratic PDFs. Stale data from third-party weather aggregators goes unnoticed, causing false panic or fatal skepticism when real disasters strike.

Figure 1: The 27 Occupation-Based Scenarios in AkashSathi. Live Screen: /#who

The Real-World Human Cost

Lightning strikes claim over 200 lives annually in rural Bangladesh. Extreme Wet Bulb Globe Temperatures (WBGT) cause heatstroke in day labourers who have no way of knowing peak hazard hours. Generic apps give numbers; vulnerable workers need immediate, context-specific decisions.

02 / The Solution & Architecture

How AkashSathi Solves the Last-Mile Gap

AkashSathi transforms raw meteorological data into direct, occupation-specific, actionable advice for all 544 upazilas of Bangladesh.

1

Ingest & Ground

Connects directly to BMD Dhaka & Rangpur Doppler radar (10 min frames), JMA Himawari-9 satellite (NASA/NOAA), Open-Meteo, Xweather lightning summaries, and extracts BMD official PDF bulletins.

2

Intelligence Engine

Evaluates incoming data against a catalog of 27 occupation rules (Farmer, Fisherman, Construction, Rickshaw puller, Vendor, Student). Calculates Heat Stress (WBGT) and verifies warning geographic boundaries.

3

Bilingual Action

Delivers structured advisories via an in-app privacy-first inbox and Telegram bot. Every card shows the exact source, timestamp, and verifiable official BMD statement link in both English and বাংলা.

Figure 2: Upazila-level Weather Map with BMD Doppler Radar.
Figure 3: 3-Tier Freshness Indicator Standard.

The Gold Standard of Weather Integrity: 3 Data Statuses

Indicator Visual Status Operational Guarantee
Fresh Data Full vibrant color Within verified freshness window (Radar < 10m, Forecast < 3h).
Outdated Data Muted tone + "Stale" Explicitly labels elapsed time so users never act on expired forecasts.
No Data Grey + "Unavailable" Crucial invariant: Unknown is NEVER rendered as calm or zero rain.

03 / Platform Capabilities

Core Features: User Experience & Administration

Designed for accessibility, transparency, and operational rigor under real-world conditions.

Figure 4: Zero-friction occupation selector (5-step wizard).

Zero-Friction, Privacy-First Signup

No passwords or accounts required. Coordinates remain entirely in the browser tab; only upazila/district area codes are linked to the alert profile. Alerts route into the native inbox instantly.

Figure 5: Native Bangla UI for grassroot accessibility.

Native Bilingual Accessibility (বাংলা & EN)

Every weather term, precaution, and bulletin quotation is rendered with equal care in Bangla and English, ensuring field workers, local union parishads, and students understand every detail.

Figure 6: Administrator Dashboard: live source ingestion.
Figure 7: Granular hazard dispatch by profession & district.

Administrative Hazard Dispatch & Audit Safety

Admins can target custom emergency warnings by profession (e.g. fishermen only in Barishal & Chattogram) and scope. All custom notifications are strictly labelled "Sent as: Administrator (not BMD)" to prevent institutional mistrust.

Video Editing & Motion Assembly Checklist

  • Audio Sync: Generate the voiceover first via ElevenLabs, then edit video clips in CapCut, Premiere, or Screen Studio to match every audio breath.
  • Background Music: Use ambient, inspiring acoustic-tech background music (e.g., gentle piano + electronic pulse) ducked at -18dB during voiceover.
  • Visual Motion: Apply subtle 105% slow push-in zoom on every screenshot to give a cinematic documentary feel.
  • Captions: Add high-contrast white text with black outline subtitles, highlighted word-by-word.
